name_zh: 保险理赔材料预检助手
desc_zh: 按险种与出险场景核对理赔材料齐备性，输出缺件清单、被退回原因与补齐路径
desc_en: Use when the user asks about insurance claim materials, rejected claims, or what documents are needed before filing a claim. Breaks requirements down by claim scenario (auto accident, medical inpatient/outpatient, critical illness, death, disability, employer liability), lists required documents with specifications, explains why claims get rejected, and gives a filing checklist. Does not decide whether a claim will be paid.
